tokens.name: cream-50
tokens.usage: Lightest surface, never pure white. Raised panels, dialogue boxes, input fills in Day.

tokens.name: cream-100
tokens.usage: Page background (Day). Text colour on Night grounds (12.8:1 on plum-900).

tokens.name: cream-200
tokens.usage: Card / panel base (Day).

tokens.name: peach-300
tokens.usage: Soft accent and hover wash; Day sky gradient end; links on Night (8.0:1 on plum-800).

tokens.name: terracotta-500
tokens.usage: Primary accent: primary buttons, active tabs, key highlights. Label text on it is `cocoa-950` (5.6:1); `cocoa-900` is 4.1:1, large text only.

tokens.name: terracotta-700
tokens.usage: Primary pressed fill. Transient state only: cream-50 on it is 4.2:1, which passes only for the 19px/800 `label-lg` button label.

tokens.name: terracotta-800
tokens.usage: Added: link and accent TEXT on light grounds (5.2:1 on cream-100, 4.7:1 on cream-200).

tokens.name: honey-400
tokens.usage: Highlights, collectibles, stars, warning fills, lamp glow, focus ring band. Never text on cream (1.6:1).

tokens.name: honey-700
tokens.usage: Added: warning TEXT on light grounds (5.2:1 on cream-100).

tokens.name: sage-400
tokens.usage: Secondary accent (nature): secondary buttons, leaves, ticks. `cocoa-900` text on it 5.5:1.

tokens.name: sage-600
tokens.usage: Success fills and icons. Not body text on cream (3.2:1) — use `sage-700`.

tokens.name: sage-700
tokens.usage: Added: success TEXT on light grounds (4.9:1 on cream-200).

tokens.name: sky-300
tokens.usage: Calm cool accent, info fills. Use sparingly — max one sky element per screen.

tokens.name: sky-700
tokens.usage: Added: info TEXT on light grounds (5.3:1 on cream-100).

tokens.name: berry-400
tokens.usage: Playful pop: notification dots, badges, error icons. Not text on cream (3.4:1).

tokens.name: berry-600
tokens.usage: Added: danger button fill (cream-50 label 5.9:1) and error TEXT on light grounds (5.5:1).

tokens.name: lavender-300
tokens.usage: Night / dreamy accent; Dusk sky gradient end; Night control outlines (6.6:1 on plum-900).

tokens.name: cocoa-950
tokens.usage: Added: label text on terracotta-500 (5.6:1). Warm, never black.

tokens.name: cocoa-900
tokens.usage: Text and outlines in Day and Dusk (10.4:1 on cream-100). Block shadows.

tokens.name: cocoa-700
tokens.usage: Secondary text on cream-100 / cream-200 (6.9:1 / 6.3:1).

tokens.name: cocoa-500
tokens.usage: Muted / disabled only. 4.0:1 on cream-100 and 3.6:1 on cream-200 — below AA for body text; never use for content.

tokens.name: plum-950
tokens.usage: Added: Night outlines and block shadows. Warm plum, never pure black.

tokens.name: plum-900
tokens.usage: Night page background (brief §4.2).

tokens.name: plum-800
tokens.usage: Night card / panel surface (brief §4.2).

tokens.name: plum-700
tokens.usage: Added: Night raised surface (dialogue boxes, inputs, HUD).

tokens.name: plum-600
tokens.usage: Added: Night sunken wells (input fills, progress tracks).

tokens.name: dusk-200
tokens.usage: Added: Dusk page background, a rosy apricot.

tokens.name: dusk-100
tokens.usage: Added: Dusk card surface.

tokens.name: wood-400
tokens.usage: Added: wooden sign top highlight (gradient start).

tokens.name: wood-600
tokens.usage: Added: wooden sign body. cream-50 text on it 5.8:1.

tokens.name: bg-page
tokens.usage: Page / world background. Overlay the 4% paper grain on it.

tokens.name: sky-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of the scene's sky gradient (Dusk: terracotta → lavender).

tokens.name: sky-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the scene's sky gradient.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, paper, panels, item cards.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Dialogue boxes, windows, HUD, inputs — the object closest to the player.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: progress tracks, slider rails, inventory slots.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg-page, surface-card and surface-raised in every theme (≥8.7:1).

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg-page, surface-card and surface-raised in every theme (≥5.8:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and placeholders only — never content. Below AA in places (Day 4.0:1 on bg-page, Dusk 3.4:1), flagged; disabled text is exempt.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Object outlines (3px, 4px hero) and block shadows. Never black.

tokens.name: outline-control
tokens.usage: Borders of form controls — holds ≥3:1 against its ground in every theme.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, active tab, selected states.

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button while pressed.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label on primary (5.6:1).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill, nature accents.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Label on secondary (5.5:1).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Danger button fill.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on danger (5.9:1).

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Stars, collectibles, rarity glows, achievement badges.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links, always underlined, on surface-card and surface-raised (≥4.7:1 every theme). On bg-page in Dusk use `ink` + underline instead (4.4:1).

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Success text with a ✓ icon or label, on surface-card and surface-raised (≥4.9:1 every theme).

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Warning text with an icon or label, on surface-card and surface-raised (≥4.7:1 every theme).

tokens.name: error-ink
tokens.usage: Error text with an icon or label, on bg-page and surface-card (≥4.6:1 every theme). On Night surface-raised it is 4.0:1 — keep error text 19px bold there or move it to the card.

tokens.name: info-ink
tokens.usage: Info text with an icon or label, on surface-card and surface-raised (≥4.8:1 every theme).

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: Lamp, candle and firefly halos (radial gradients, shadow-glow).

tokens.name: vignette
tokens.usage: Warm vignette at the scene's edges.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind modal game windows.

styles.name: title-80
styles.usage: Title screen logo only. Fluid: clamp(48px, 8vw, 80px).

styles.name: title-64
styles.usage: Location names on room entry. clamp(40px, 6vw, 64px).

styles.name: title-28
styles.usage: H3, window titles, item names in inspect view.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Pull up a chair — the kettle's on.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: I build tiny tools and tell stories about them.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Hints and metadata under content; never paragraphs.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Tiny labels on stickers and tags only.

styles.name: label-lg
styles.usage: Medium/large button labels (19px/800 counts as large text).

styles.name: pixel-dialogue
styles.usage: Dialogue box text and NPC lines only.

styles.name: pixel-hud
styles.usage: HUD counters, stats, short game labels (under ~6 words).

spacing.note: 4px base. Space between objects in a scene is looser than inside them.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label in buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Small button padding, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and input padding; mobile side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Dialogue box and window padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between groups inside a room.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Section spacing on mobile.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing on desktop.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Gap between scenes / chapters.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Title-screen breathing room.

radius.note: No sharp corners anywhere except pixel-art sprites.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, chips inner, tooltips tails, small slots.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, inventory slots.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogue boxes, HUD.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Game windows, scene frames.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, toggles, progress bars, icon buttons.

shadow.note: Block shadows, never blurry drop shadows. Pressed removes the offset and translates the element by the same amount.

tokens.name: shadow-block
tokens.usage: Raised objects: buttons, cards, windows.

tokens.name: shadow-block-sm
tokens.usage: Small controls: checkboxes, chips, icon buttons at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-block-lg
tokens.usage: Hero objects: title logo plate, game windows.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: Lights: lamps, candles, collectibles, legendary items.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: honey band edged in cocoa (Day/Dusk) or cream (Night) so it holds ≥3:1 on every ground. Combine with shadow-block.

tokens.name: border-width
tokens.usage: Every outlined object.

tokens.name: border-width-hero
tokens.usage: Hero objects: title plate, game windows, mascot.

tokens.name: icon-stroke
tokens.usage: Stroke of 24px icons (round caps and joins).

tokens.name: duration-micro
tokens.usage: Press squish, hover tick.

tokens.name: duration-ui
tokens.usage: Hover lift, toggles, tooltips.

tokens.name: duration-transition
tokens.usage: Windows opening, toasts, drawers.

tokens.name: duration-scene
tokens.usage: Room changes, page turns; ambient loops are 2.4s+.

tokens.usage: Default for fades and colour changes.

tokens.name: ease-bounce
tokens.usage: Pops, lifts, toasts arriving, collect sparkles.

tokens.name: ease-gentle
tokens.usage: Scene transitions, parallax, drawers.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Large phones.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablets: simplified scene.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Full interactive scene.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Wide scenes.

tokens.name: bp-2xl
tokens.usage: Full-bleed hero worlds.

tokens.name: grain-opacity
tokens.usage: Paper/fabric grain overlay (3–6% range).

tokens.name: disabled-opacity
tokens.usage: Disabled controls (also drop the block shadow).

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for any interactive object.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of reading sections; scenes may be full-bleed.

tokens.usage: Default icon grid.
